generation_request.prompt: TWILIGHT PR122 legendary transform:402 세계수의 현신. The attached original catalog PNG is authoritative for the character identity. Create one production animation SOURCE PNG with exactly SIX newly drawn full-body SOUTH-facing ATTACK poses, arranged precisely THREE equal columns by TWO equal rows, reading order frame0..5. Paint detailed isometric fantasy game sprites consistent with reference, no generic replacement, no image rotation or translated still. Each cell contains the whole body, hair crown, toes, heels and complete blade with generous transparent margins and gutters. No clipping or overlap, no text, labels, grid, background, ground plane or additional characters. Output only the one transparent six-frame source sheet.
